name: Magpie
summary: An SRAD Fracture Test Module carrying epoxy test articles, flown on Osiris to test how a self-healing polymer performs under real flight loads.
detail: Magpie is the team's first scientific payload: a self-contained module that initiates and propagates small cracks in epoxy test articles during flight, as a proof of concept for using self-healing polymers in aerospace structures. It flew on Osiris and won first place in the Payload Challenge at Launch Canada 2026.

name: Sparrow
summary: A 360-degree camera paired with a recovery beacon, flown on Nimbus. Won first place in the Payload Challenge at Launch Canada 2025.
detail: Sparrow paired a 360-degree camera with a recovery beacon: full-flight footage in every direction, plus a way to find the airframe faster after it lands. It flew on Nimbus and won first place in the Payload Challenge at Launch Canada 2025.
